name: grass_tuft
notes: 8 curved tapered blades, dark root to full-color tip. Grass is single-sided with terrain (up) normals so it lights like the ground; DoubleSide only with the back-face normal flip disabled.

name: grass_tall
notes: 12 lush blades. Same Grass setup as grass_tuft.

name: dune_grass
notes: 6 wiry splayed blades + 2 dry stubs. Same Grass setup as grass_tuft.

name: reed_clump
notes: 8 reed leaves (Grass, same setup as grass_tuft) and 2 cattails with Bark heads.

name: flower_a
notes: Stem, 3 leaves, 6-petal cupped bloom facing -Y and up with a Glow bead, closed bud. Petals and leaves are single planes: render Leaf/Petal DoubleSide.

name: fern_a
notes: 6 arching pinnate fronds (single planes): render Leaf DoubleSide.

name: glow_bulb
notes: Lantern plant for bioluminescent nights: 3 arching stems with hanging Glow bulbs under star hoods, 3 basal leaves (Leaf DoubleSide).

name: bush_round
notes: 3 soft clumped foliage masses + 1 LeafAlt highlight lobe; closed meshes (single-sided safe). Walk-through, no collider.

name: cactus_alien
notes: Bulbous ribbed column with two curving arms, Glow crowns and areole studs. Collider covers the main column.

name: coral_fan
notes: Knobby finger coral fanning out in the X-Z plane (faces -Y), cupped toward -Y. Closed tubes; walk-through.

name: tree_round
notes: Broadleaf tree: S-curved trunk with root flare and a fork, 5 soft clumped foliage masses + 3 LeafAlt highlight lobes (closed meshes). Collider = trunk.

name: tree_pine
notes: Stylized conifer: 6 stacked drooping scalloped tiers (closed). Collider = trunk.

name: tree_umbrella
notes: Alien mushroom tree: curved stem with a skirt ring, wide scalloped cap, 16 Glow spots underneath. Collider = stem.

name: tree_palm
notes: Ringed trunk curving toward +X, 9 pinnate drooping fronds (Leaf DoubleSide: they are seen from below), 3 coconuts. Collider = lower trunk.

name: rock_boulder
notes: Rounded boulder with planar chisel facets and soft bevels; sunk 12 cm.

name: rock_slab
notes: 3 tilted angular plates, broken corner: Rock tops, RockDark strata sides; low edge buried.

name: rock_spire
notes: Organic leaning hoodoo spire: one irregular column with dipping strata (soft eroded waists with RockDark undercuts under chunky lopsided Rock caprock ledges), chiselled flank facets and peak.

name: rock_pebbles
notes: Cluster of 5 smooth river stones; decor, no collider.

name: mesa_chunk
notes: Mid/far-distance butte: talus skirt, 3 strata (RockDark middle), flat top; ~38 m wide, ~25 m tall. Collider approximates the cliff core.

name: sandstone_arch
notes: Natural arch spanning X, opening faces -Y; thin RockDark strata, talus boulders. collider is null so the opening stays walkable: use `colliders` (two leg cylinders, offset in three.js space [x, y, z]).

name: crystal_cluster
notes: 7 hexagonal crystals (3 with chamfered edges) on a rock base; flat facets.

name: crystal_spire
notes: One ~10.5 m chamfered crystal, a leaning companion and 4 small crystals on a rock base.

name: shard
notes: Floating resonance shard: faceted gem + tilted Glow orbit ring. Origin at its center (bob/spin it in code); sphere collider centered on the origin.
